units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - A|Your ship narrowly avoids a few small Coalition vessels as you exit <origin>'s atmosphere. Not a second later, while you're still stunned by the near-crash, once again the <ship> is almost hit by incoming ships, this time Heliarch warships, in what looks like an intense chase after the ships from before.|251|0
units.english: Your ship narrowly avoids a few small Coalition vessels as you exit <origin>'s atmosphere. Not a second later, while you're still stunned by the near-crash, once again the <ship> is almost hit by incoming ships, this time Heliarch warships, in what looks like an intense chase after the ships from before.
units.italian: La vostra nave evita per un soffio alcune piccole navi della Coalizione mentre uscite dall'atmosfera di <origin>. Nemmeno un secondo dopo, mentre siete ancora storditi dallo scampato urto, la <ship> rischia di nuovo di essere colpita da navi in arrivo, questa volta da navi da guerra Heliarch, in quella che sembra un inseguimento serrato alle navi di prima.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - A|	After they've all passed, you check your comms and radar, finding some other civilian ships nearby that seem to have experienced a similar shock of their own. Some of the ships linger over <origin> for a while, as if unsure of what to do. Others bolt away with engines at full power, leaving the system in a blink, and some eventually decide to land again, either too curious about the situation, or perhaps wanting to avoid any trouble.|252|0
units.english: After they've all passed, you check your comms and radar, finding some other civilian ships nearby that seem to have experienced a similar shock of their own. Some of the ships linger over <origin> for a while, as if unsure of what to do. Others bolt away with engines at full power, leaving the system in a blink, and some eventually decide to land again, either too curious about the situation, or perhaps wanting to avoid any trouble.
units.italian: Dopo che sono passate tutte, controllate le comunicazioni e il radar e trovate altre navi civili nei paraggi che sembrano aver provato uno shock simile al vostro. Alcune navi restano sospese sopra <origin> per un po', come se non sapessero cosa fare. Altre scattano via con i motori a piena potenza e lasciano il sistema in un battito di ciglia; altre ancora decidono alla fine di atterrare di nuovo, o troppo curiose della situazione, o forse desiderose di evitare guai.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - A|	Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet. They pay you no mind, and much to your relief steer a safe distance from your ship this time.|257|0
units.english: Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet. They pay you no mind, and much to your relief steer a safe distance from your ship this time.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, vedete alcune navi Heliarch fra quelle che vi erano passate vicine lasciare il pianeta. Non vi badano e, con vostro grande sollievo, questa volta mantengono una distanza di sicurezza dalla vostra nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - A|	Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet, steering a safe distance from your ship this time. The captain of one of the ships, a Heliarch Interdictor, hails you, apologizing for the earlier distress, briefly mentioning they've gotten the situation back under control. They wish you a good day, and prepare to leave the system.|260|0
units.english: Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet, steering a safe distance from your ship this time. The captain of one of the ships, a Heliarch Interdictor, hails you, apologizing for the earlier distress, briefly mentioning they've gotten the situation back under control. They wish you a good day, and prepare to leave the system.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, vedete alcune navi Heliarch fra quelle che vi erano passate vicine lasciare il pianeta, mantenendo questa volta una distanza di sicurezza dalla vostra nave. Il capitano di una di esse, un Interdictor Heliarch, vi chiama, si scusa per il disturbo di prima e accenna brevemente al fatto che hanno riportato la situazione sotto controllo. Vi augura buona giornata e si prepara a lasciare il sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - A|	Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet. They pay you no mind, and much to your relief steer a safe distance away from your ship this time. You cannot help but wonder whether the ships they were chasing held any Lunarium members, or if they were simply more unfortunate civilians.|263|0
units.english: Some more minutes later, you see a select few of the Heliarch ships that passed close to you departing the planet. They pay you no mind, and much to your relief steer a safe distance away from your ship this time. You cannot help but wonder whether the ships they were chasing held any Lunarium members, or if they were simply more unfortunate civilians.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, vedete alcune navi Heliarch fra quelle che vi erano passate vicine lasciare il pianeta. Non vi badano e, con vostro grande sollievo, questa volta mantengono una distanza di sicurezza dalla vostra nave. Non potete fare a meno di chiedervi se le navi che stavano inseguendo portassero membri del Lunarium, o se fossero soltanto altri civili sfortunati.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|Once you're a good distance from <origin>, your sensors alert you to danger in the system: several explosions and a torrent of projectiles are flying nearby. You swiftly ready yourself and prepare for the threat, only to find Coalition civilian ships blowing up near the middle of the system. Some Heliarch warships are in their midst, moving from one to the other, unbothered by the ship debris as vessels explode around them.|287|0
units.english: Once you're a good distance from <origin>, your sensors alert you to danger in the system: several explosions and a torrent of projectiles are flying nearby. You swiftly ready yourself and prepare for the threat, only to find Coalition civilian ships blowing up near the middle of the system. Some Heliarch warships are in their midst, moving from one to the other, unbothered by the ship debris as vessels explode around them.
units.italian: Quando siete a buona distanza da <origin>, i sensori vi segnalano pericolo nel sistema: diverse esplosioni e un torrente di proiettili attraversano lo spazio vicino. Vi preparate in fretta alla minaccia, per scoprire poi che sono navi civili della Coalizione a saltare in aria verso il centro del sistema. Alcune navi da guerra Heliarch stanno in mezzo a loro e passano dall'una all'altra, indifferenti ai rottami mentre i vascelli esplodono intorno a loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|	They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.|296|0
units.english: They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.
units.italian: Sembrano abbordare le poche navi non danneggiate abbastanza da avere lo scafo squarciato. Dopo pochi minuti sembrano averne preso il controllo e le fanno seguire le navi da guerra fuori dal sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|	One of the ships hails you briefly, apparently in a cheery mood as they celebrate having captured the criminals. They wish you a good day and good luck on your duties, and cut the comms as they prepare to leave.|297|0
units.english: One of the ships hails you briefly, apparently in a cheery mood as they celebrate having captured the criminals. They wish you a good day and good luck on your duties, and cut the comms as they prepare to leave.
units.italian: Una delle navi vi chiama brevemente, apparentemente di buon umore mentre festeggia la cattura dei criminali. Vi augura buona giornata e buona fortuna nei vostri incarichi, e chiude le comunicazioni mentre si prepara a partire.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|	They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.|300|0
units.english: They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.
units.italian: Sembrano abbordare le poche navi non danneggiate abbastanza da avere lo scafo squarciato. Dopo pochi minuti sembrano averne preso il controllo e le fanno seguire le navi da guerra fuori dal sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|	As you glance at the wreckage of the civilian ships, you feel uneasy. Worse still is the thought that hits you soon after, of whether any of the Lunarium leaders you met were aboard any of the ships.|301|0
units.english: As you glance at the wreckage of the civilian ships, you feel uneasy. Worse still is the thought that hits you soon after, of whether any of the Lunarium leaders you met were aboard any of the ships.
units.italian: Mentre date un'occhiata ai rottami delle navi civili, provate un senso di disagio. Peggio ancora è il pensiero che vi colpisce poco dopo: se qualcuno dei capi del Lunarium che avete incontrato fosse a bordo di una di quelle navi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - B|	They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.|304|0
units.english: They appear to be boarding the few ships that weren't damaged enough to have their hulls ruptured. After a few short minutes, they seem to have seized control of the vessels, and are having them follow the warships out of the system.
units.italian: Sembrano abbordare le poche navi non danneggiate abbastanza da avere lo scafo squarciato. Dopo pochi minuti sembrano averne preso il controllo e le fanno seguire le navi da guerra fuori dal sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|You depart to find something like a screen of Heliarch warships around <origin>, circling it and approaching all departing civilian ships. It's no different with your <ship>, and soon enough you're hailed by a Heliarch Punisher approaching your position.|347|0
units.english: You depart to find something like a screen of Heliarch warships around <origin>, circling it and approaching all departing civilian ships. It's no different with your <ship>, and soon enough you're hailed by a Heliarch Punisher approaching your position.
units.italian: Partite e trovate una specie di schermo di navi da guerra Heliarch intorno a <origin>, che la circondano e si avvicinano a tutte le navi civili in partenza. Non va diversamente per la vostra <ship>, e ben presto venite chiamati da un Punisher Heliarch che si avvicina alla vostra posizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|	"Salutations, Captain <last>. Performing a routine inspection, we are. Board you momentarily we shall, to verify the safety of your vessel, then leave you to your business we shall."|348|0
units.english: "Salutations, Captain <last>. Performing a routine inspection, we are. Board you momentarily we shall, to verify the safety of your vessel, then leave you to your business we shall."
units.italian: "Saluti, Capitano <last>. Un'ispezione di routine, stiamo facendo. Vi abbordiamo tra un momento, per verificare la sicurezza della vostra nave, poi vi lasciamo ai vostri affari."

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|	They sign off before you can respond, and the Punisher readies to board the <ship>, as more warships gather around the scene. Dozens of armed Heliarch agents march into your ship silently, diligently going about checking the bunks, cockpit, engine room...|351|0
units.english: They sign off before you can respond, and the Punisher readies to board the <ship>, as more warships gather around the scene. Dozens of armed Heliarch agents march into your ship silently, diligently going about checking the bunks, cockpit, engine room...
units.italian: Chiudono la comunicazione prima che possiate rispondere, e il Punisher si prepara ad abbordare la <ship>, mentre altre navi da guerra si radunano intorno alla scena. Decine di agenti Heliarch armati entrano in silenzio nella vostra nave e controllano con diligenza le cuccette, la cabina di pilotaggio, la sala macchine...

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|	Within a few minutes, they appear satisfied with turning your ship upside down, and all march back to the Punisher. They thank you for "cooperating," and the ships clear the way for you to move out.|352|0
units.english: Within a few minutes, they appear satisfied with turning your ship upside down, and all march back to the Punisher. They thank you for "cooperating," and the ships clear the way for you to move out.
units.italian: In pochi minuti sembrano soddisfatti di aver messo la vostra nave sottosopra, e tornano tutti al Punisher. Vi ringraziano per la "collaborazione," e le navi vi aprono la strada per ripartire.

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|	They sign off before you can respond, and the Punisher readies to board the <ship> as more warships gather around the scene. Although you're not currently performing any tasks for the Lunarium, you still grow increasingly worried as the Punisher approaches and connects to your ship. You do your best to keep a calm profile as dozens of armed Heliarch agents march into your ship silently, diligently going about checking the bunks, cockpit, engine room...|355|0
units.english: They sign off before you can respond, and the Punisher readies to board the <ship> as more warships gather around the scene. Although you're not currently performing any tasks for the Lunarium, you still grow increasingly worried as the Punisher approaches and connects to your ship. You do your best to keep a calm profile as dozens of armed Heliarch agents march into your ship silently, diligently going about checking the bunks, cockpit, engine room...
units.italian: Chiudono la comunicazione prima che possiate rispondere, e il Punisher si prepara ad abbordare la <ship> mentre altre navi da guerra si radunano intorno alla scena. Benché non stiate svolgendo alcun incarico per il Lunarium, la preoccupazione cresce mentre il Punisher si avvicina e si collega alla vostra nave. Fate del vostro meglio per mantenere un contegno calmo mentre decine di agenti Heliarch armati entrano in silenzio nella vostra nave e controllano con diligenza le cuccette, la cabina di pilotaggio, la sala macchine...

units.id: mission:Coalition Departing Trouble - C|	Within a few minutes, they appear satisfied with turning your ship upside down, and all march back to the Punisher. They thank you for "cooperating", and the ships clear the way for you to move out. Once they're well enough away from the <ship>, you take to scouring it for anything they might've left behind to keep tabs within your ship. Much later on in the day, after you've confirmed to have found nothing of the sort, you breathe a sigh of relief.|356|0
units.english: Within a few minutes, they appear satisfied with turning your ship upside down, and all march back to the Punisher. They thank you for "cooperating", and the ships clear the way for you to move out. Once they're well enough away from the <ship>, you take to scouring it for anything they might've left behind to keep tabs within your ship. Much later on in the day, after you've confirmed to have found nothing of the sort, you breathe a sigh of relief.
units.italian: In pochi minuti sembrano soddisfatti di aver messo la vostra nave sottosopra, e tornano tutti al Punisher. Vi ringraziano per la "collaborazione", e le navi vi aprono la strada per ripartire. Quando sono abbastanza lontani dalla <ship>, cominciate a setacciarla in cerca di qualcosa che possano aver lasciato per tenervi d'occhio. Molto più tardi nella giornata, dopo aver verificato che non c'è nulla del genere, tirate un sospiro di sollievo.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|You see an Arach captain hurrying around the spaceport, speaking with anyone who will listen. He converses with each one briefly, showing something in a small monitor, and then moving on to the next shortly after. After a while, he gets to you.|394|0
units.english: You see an Arach captain hurrying around the spaceport, speaking with anyone who will listen. He converses with each one briefly, showing something in a small monitor, and then moving on to the next shortly after. After a while, he gets to you.
units.italian: Vedete un capitano Arach che si aggira di fretta per lo spazioporto, parlando con chiunque sia disposto ad ascoltarlo. Conversa brevemente con ognuno, mostrando qualcosa in un piccolo monitor, e poco dopo passa al successivo. Dopo un po' arriva a voi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|	"Captain? A moment if free you are?" He asks, scrambling his legs to light up the monitor. It displays a picture of a young Kimek. "A passenger of mine. Stopped by here to drop a few Saryd pilgrims, we had, but after seen them off I had, find this Kimek back in my ship, I couldn't!" He exclaims, pointing to an Arach Transport parked just before the edge of where <origin>'s dense fog cuts off your view. "Seen him anywhere, have you?"|395|0
units.english: "Captain? A moment if free you are?" He asks, scrambling his legs to light up the monitor. It displays a picture of a young Kimek. "A passenger of mine. Stopped by here to drop a few Saryd pilgrims, we had, but after seen them off I had, find this Kimek back in my ship, I couldn't!" He exclaims, pointing to an Arach Transport parked just before the edge of where <origin>'s dense fog cuts off your view. "Seen him anywhere, have you?"
units.italian: "Capitano? Un momento, se siete liberi?" chiede, agitando le zampe per accendere il monitor. Mostra l'immagine di un giovane Kimek. "Un mio passeggero. Fermato qui per far scendere alcuni pellegrini Saryd, ci eravamo, ma dopo averli salutati, ritrovare questo Kimek nella mia nave, non sono riuscito!" esclama, indicando un Transport Arach parcheggiato appena prima del punto in cui la nebbia fitta di <origin> vi toglie la vista. "Visto da qualche parte, l'avete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|	"Sorry, I haven't. Did you try getting in touch with the local Heliarchs?"|397|0
units.english: "Sorry, I haven't. Did you try getting in touch with the local Heliarchs?"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, no. Avete provato a contattare gli Heliarch locali?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|	"Sorry, but I haven't seen him either."|398|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I haven't seen him either."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non l'ho visto nemmeno io."

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|	He nods. "Contacted them a few hours ago, I had. Look for my passenger in the restricted sections, I wished to, but allowed there I am not, so figured that ask them for aid, I could." He sighs. "Filed a report and sent a few agents off to look for him, they did, but so far received any word from them, I have not."|400|0
units.english: He nods. "Contacted them a few hours ago, I had. Look for my passenger in the restricted sections, I wished to, but allowed there I am not, so figured that ask them for aid, I could." He sighs. "Filed a report and sent a few agents off to look for him, they did, but so far received any word from them, I have not."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Contattati un paio d'ore fa, li avevo. Cercare il mio passeggero nelle sezioni riservate, avrei voluto, ma lì non sono ammesso, quindi ho pensato di chiedere il loro aiuto." Sospira. "Presentato un rapporto e mandato alcuni agenti a cercarlo, l'hanno fatto, ma finora nessuna notizia da loro, non ho ricevuto."

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Secret Sky|	He thanks you all the same for listening to him, and moves on to the next person in the spaceport to inquire about the missing Kimek.|402|0
units.english: He thanks you all the same for listening to him, and moves on to the next person in the spaceport to inquire about the missing Kimek.
units.italian: Vi ringrazia comunque per averlo ascoltato e passa alla persona successiva nello spazioporto per chiedere del Kimek scomparso.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Hunger Tower|The spaceport here on <origin> is in something of an uproar. Thousands of Kimek are seemingly organized in what, strangely enough for a world in the Coalition, resembles a protest. Some carry devices repeatedly displaying a message in the Kimek language. Others hold signs depicting the usual Kimek diet, with their many crops sharing space with a few fish. Strangest of all, however, is how the local Heliarchs are handling the situation: they appear almost hesitant, defensively speaking to the civilians in attempts to calm them down, sometimes apologizing or simply being forced to listen to the complaints as several Kimek pile up around them.|420|0
units.english: The spaceport here on <origin> is in something of an uproar. Thousands of Kimek are seemingly organized in what, strangely enough for a world in the Coalition, resembles a protest. Some carry devices repeatedly displaying a message in the Kimek language. Others hold signs depicting the usual Kimek diet, with their many crops sharing space with a few fish. Strangest of all, however, is how the local Heliarchs are handling the situation: they appear almost hesitant, defensively speaking to the civilians in attempts to calm them down, sometimes apologizing or simply being forced to listen to the complaints as several Kimek pile up around them.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto qui su <origin> è nel pieno di un trambusto. Migliaia di Kimek sembrano organizzati in quella che, cosa strana per un mondo della Coalizione, somiglia a una protesta. Alcuni portano dispositivi che ripetono un messaggio in lingua Kimek. Altri tengono cartelli che raffigurano la solita dieta Kimek, con i loro molti raccolti che condividono lo spazio con qualche pesce. La cosa più strana, però, è come gli Heliarch locali stanno gestendo la situazione: sembrano quasi esitanti, parlano ai civili in tono difensivo per cercare di calmarli, a volte si scusano o sono semplicemente costretti ad ascoltare le lamentele mentre diversi Kimek si accalcano intorno a loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Hunger Tower|	When you finally manage to find a Heliarch who isn't occupied trying to keep the area in order, a Saryd, he explains the situation. "Missed its delivery, a food convoy has. Still investigating the issue, we are; know only that, somehow, gone missing, the entire fleet has..." He sighs, shaking his head. "Keep the locals calm we must." He goes on to help the other Heliarchs, without another word.|421|0
units.english: When you finally manage to find a Heliarch who isn't occupied trying to keep the area in order, a Saryd, he explains the situation. "Missed its delivery, a food convoy has. Still investigating the issue, we are; know only that, somehow, gone missing, the entire fleet has..." He sighs, shaking his head. "Keep the locals calm we must." He goes on to help the other Heliarchs, without another word.
units.italian: Quando alla fine riuscite a trovare un Heliarch non impegnato a tenere in ordine la zona, un Saryd, vi spiega la situazione. "Mancato la sua consegna, un convoglio di cibo ha. Ancora indaghiamo sul problema, noi; sappiamo solo che, in qualche modo, scomparsa, l'intera flotta è..." Sospira, scuotendo la testa. "Tenere calmi i locali, dobbiamo." Si allontana ad aiutare gli altri Heliarch, senza aggiungere altro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Hunger Tower|	Within a few minutes that must've felt like hours for the stationed Heliarch agents, battalions of drones start making their way from the tallest building in the city - the hunger tower. Ferrying around several meals each, with impressive precision, the drones fly throughout the civilian mass, distributing the meals. Hundreds of larger ones head to the residential areas of the city, presumably to provide the necessary supplies for the citizens until the next food convoy arrives. Seemingly satisfied, for the moment at least, the Kimek gradually dissipate out of the spaceport and back to their homes, leaving the spaceport to the now exhausted Heliarch agents.|422|0
units.english: Within a few minutes that must've felt like hours for the stationed Heliarch agents, battalions of drones start making their way from the tallest building in the city - the hunger tower. Ferrying around several meals each, with impressive precision, the drones fly throughout the civilian mass, distributing the meals. Hundreds of larger ones head to the residential areas of the city, presumably to provide the necessary supplies for the citizens until the next food convoy arrives. Seemingly satisfied, for the moment at least, the Kimek gradually dissipate out of the spaceport and back to their homes, leaving the spaceport to the now exhausted Heliarch agents.
units.italian: In pochi minuti che agli agenti Heliarch di stanza saranno sembrati ore, battaglioni di droni cominciano a uscire dall'edificio più alto della città: la torre della fame. Trasportando ciascuno diversi pasti, con una precisione impressionante, i droni volano fra la massa dei civili e distribuiscono il cibo. Centinaia di droni più grandi si dirigono verso le zone residenziali, presumibilmente per fornire ai cittadini le scorte necessarie fino all'arrivo del prossimo convoglio. Apparentemente soddisfatti, almeno per il momento, i Kimek si disperdono via via dallo spazioporto verso casa, lasciando lo spazioporto agli agenti Heliarch ormai esausti.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Arach Store|A Heliarch patrol seems to be discussing with an Arach shop worker in front of a large, prestigious looking Arach clothing store in the spaceport. Other agents prevent you and other bystanders from approaching the scene, but you can still make out some context from their gesturing. It seems the Heliarchs are there to confiscate some pieces from the shop that you guess don't abide by their laws, while the shop worker keeps worryingly attempting to answer what questions they pose him.|440|0
units.english: A Heliarch patrol seems to be discussing with an Arach shop worker in front of a large, prestigious looking Arach clothing store in the spaceport. Other agents prevent you and other bystanders from approaching the scene, but you can still make out some context from their gesturing. It seems the Heliarchs are there to confiscate some pieces from the shop that you guess don't abide by their laws, while the shop worker keeps worryingly attempting to answer what questions they pose him.
units.italian: Una pattuglia Heliarch sembra discutere con un commesso Arach davanti a un grande negozio di abbigliamento Arach dall'aspetto prestigioso, nello spazioporto. Altri agenti impediscono a voi e agli altri presenti di avvicinarvi, ma dai loro gesti riuscite comunque a capire qualcosa. Sembra che gli Heliarch siano lì per confiscare alcuni capi del negozio che, immaginate, non rispettano le loro leggi, mentre il commesso cerca con preoccupazione di rispondere alle domande che gli pongono.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Arach Store|	Eventually, the shop owner arrives. Judging by her fine clothes, and from the reactions of the local Arachi, you figure she must either be really famous here on <origin>, or possibly belong to one of the Arach Houses, though nothing on her attire seems to indicate any specific house. She helps the worker calm down, and then she engages in conversation with the Heliarch agents as he heads back inside.|441|0
units.english: Eventually, the shop owner arrives. Judging by her fine clothes, and from the reactions of the local Arachi, you figure she must either be really famous here on <origin>, or possibly belong to one of the Arach Houses, though nothing on her attire seems to indicate any specific house. She helps the worker calm down, and then she engages in conversation with the Heliarch agents as he heads back inside.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva la proprietaria del negozio. A giudicare dai suoi abiti raffinati e dalle reazioni degli Arach del posto, immaginate che sia molto famosa qui su <origin>, o forse che appartenga a una delle Casate Arach, anche se nulla nel suo abbigliamento sembra indicare una Casata precisa. Aiuta il commesso a calmarsi, poi si mette a conversare con gli agenti Heliarch mentre lui rientra nel negozio.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Arach Store|	She tries to diffuse the situation, speaking calmly and attempting to take the items back into the shop, but the Heliarch agents do not budge. Running out of patience, the Heliarch in charge of the patrol cuts the Arach lady off as she's speaking, forcibly taking all the items in question, and having the agents rip apart what you guess must've been the offending parts of the cloth pieces. Stunned, the Arach simply watches as they render most of the items into unusable rags, keeping the bits they hacked away, and handing her back the other tattered remains. Without another word, they leave the scene. The Arach heads inside, and you can hear the door slam from where you're standing.|442|0
units.english: She tries to diffuse the situation, speaking calmly and attempting to take the items back into the shop, but the Heliarch agents do not budge. Running out of patience, the Heliarch in charge of the patrol cuts the Arach lady off as she's speaking, forcibly taking all the items in question, and having the agents rip apart what you guess must've been the offending parts of the cloth pieces. Stunned, the Arach simply watches as they render most of the items into unusable rags, keeping the bits they hacked away, and handing her back the other tattered remains. Without another word, they leave the scene. The Arach heads inside, and you can hear the door slam from where you're standing.
units.italian: Cerca di sdrammatizzare, parlando con calma e tentando di riportare i capi dentro il negozio, ma gli agenti Heliarch non cedono. Persa la pazienza, l'Heliarch a capo della pattuglia la interrompe mentre parla, prende con la forza tutti i capi in questione e fa strappare dagli agenti quelle che immaginate essere le parti incriminate dei tessuti. Sbalordita, l'Arach guarda mentre riducono la maggior parte dei capi a stracci inutilizzabili, tenendosi i pezzi che hanno tagliato e restituendole gli altri resti laceri. Senza aggiungere parola, lasciano la scena. L'Arach rientra, e da dove siete potete sentire la porta sbattere.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|A few minutes into your walk around the spaceport of the <origin>, the lighting suddenly shifts from the usual, comfortable tones to a cacophony of flashing warnings. Diagnostic warning messages display on all sorts of screens, and siren blasts are interrupted only by alarm messages in all three Coalition languages on repeat. You notice that not only are the civilians in the ring as alarmed as you, but every Heliarch agent you can see begins moving in a hurried, albeit organized pace, towards restricted sections, Heliarch-only rooms and warehouses.|456|0
units.english: A few minutes into your walk around the spaceport of the <origin>, the lighting suddenly shifts from the usual, comfortable tones to a cacophony of flashing warnings. Diagnostic warning messages display on all sorts of screens, and siren blasts are interrupted only by alarm messages in all three Coalition languages on repeat. You notice that not only are the civilians in the ring as alarmed as you, but every Heliarch agent you can see begins moving in a hurried, albeit organized pace, towards restricted sections, Heliarch-only rooms and warehouses.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto che camminate per lo spazioporto di <origin>, l'illuminazione passa all'improvviso dalle solite tonalità riposanti a una cacofonia di segnalazioni lampeggianti. Messaggi di avviso diagnostico compaiono su ogni tipo di schermo, e le sirene sono interrotte solo da messaggi d'allarme ripetuti in tutte e tre le lingue della Coalizione. Notate che non solo i civili nell'anello sono allarmati come voi, ma ogni agente Heliarch in vista comincia a muoversi a passo frettoloso, anche se ordinato, verso le sezioni riservate, le stanze e i magazzini riservati agli Heliarch.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	It doesn't take long before hundreds of other Heliarchs come pouring in from other sections of the ring. When the stream finally stops, you see them take control of the machinery near the edge of the ring section, activating a huge retractable barrier that seals this section off from the rest of the ring. Ship traffic is also cut off entirely, with Heliarch squadrons keeping any ship from departing, and warships visibly walling off the hangar entrances. The Heliarchs organize the civilians swiftly, moving them away from an area where most of the agents are gathering.|457|0
units.english: It doesn't take long before hundreds of other Heliarchs come pouring in from other sections of the ring. When the stream finally stops, you see them take control of the machinery near the edge of the ring section, activating a huge retractable barrier that seals this section off from the rest of the ring. Ship traffic is also cut off entirely, with Heliarch squadrons keeping any ship from departing, and warships visibly walling off the hangar entrances. The Heliarchs organize the civilians swiftly, moving them away from an area where most of the agents are gathering.
units.italian: Non passa molto prima che centinaia di altri Heliarch arrivino da altre sezioni dell'anello. Quando il flusso finalmente si ferma, li vedete prendere il controllo dei macchinari vicino al bordo della sezione, attivando un'enorme barriera retrattile che isola questa parte dal resto dell'anello. Anche il traffico delle navi viene interrotto del tutto: squadroni Heliarch impediscono a qualunque nave di partire e navi da guerra sbarrano visibilmente gli ingressi degli hangar. Gli Heliarch organizzano i civili in fretta, allontanandoli dalla zona dove si sta radunando la maggior parte degli agenti.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	As you too are herded away by the agents, you manage to get some context out of one of them - a Heliarch team that was exploring one of the ring's unknown sections had some sort of accident, and one of the members is expected to return at the area where most of the agents are gathering. The Heliarchs stand armed and ready, pointing their weapons toward a door leading to the restricted sections, and as if rendered mute by anticipation, all in the quarantined ring section appear to hold their breath, waiting.|458|0
units.english: As you too are herded away by the agents, you manage to get some context out of one of them - a Heliarch team that was exploring one of the ring's unknown sections had some sort of accident, and one of the members is expected to return at the area where most of the agents are gathering. The Heliarchs stand armed and ready, pointing their weapons toward a door leading to the restricted sections, and as if rendered mute by anticipation, all in the quarantined ring section appear to hold their breath, waiting.
units.italian: Mentre anche voi venite sospinti via dagli agenti, riuscite a strappare qualche informazione a uno di loro: una squadra Heliarch che esplorava una delle sezioni sconosciute dell'anello ha avuto una specie di incidente, e uno dei membri dovrebbe tornare nella zona dove si sta radunando la maggior parte degli agenti. Gli Heliarch restano in armi, pronti, con le armi puntate verso una porta che dà alle sezioni riservate e, come resi muti dall'attesa, tutti nella sezione in quarantena sembrano trattenere il respiro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	Sure enough, the many minutes of silence are disrupted by echoing, increasingly louder screaming - one scream, incessant, coming from the shut passageway watched over by the sights of what must be a hundred Heliarch guns. A thud at the shut door briefly peaks out amidst the continuous shout. It opens to a lone, frantic Saryd, with a deeply perturbed look in his eyes. He doesn't stop at the sight of the several gun barrels pointed at him, instead drawing his own weapon, only to point it back to where he came from, firing wildly at the dark passage.|459|0
units.english: Sure enough, the many minutes of silence are disrupted by echoing, increasingly louder screaming - one scream, incessant, coming from the shut passageway watched over by the sights of what must be a hundred Heliarch guns. A thud at the shut door briefly peaks out amidst the continuous shout. It opens to a lone, frantic Saryd, with a deeply perturbed look in his eyes. He doesn't stop at the sight of the several gun barrels pointed at him, instead drawing his own weapon, only to point it back to where he came from, firing wildly at the dark passage.
units.italian: In effetti, i molti minuti di silenzio sono rotti da urla che riecheggiano e si fanno sempre più forti: un'unica voce, incessante, che arriva dal passaggio chiuso sorvegliato dalle canne di quello che dev'essere un centinaio di fucili Heliarch. Un tonfo alla porta chiusa si fa strada per un istante fra le grida continue. La porta si apre su un Saryd solo e fuori di sé, con lo sguardo profondamente sconvolto. Non si ferma alla vista delle canne puntate contro di lui: estrae la propria arma e la punta verso il punto da cui è venuto, sparando all'impazzata nel passaggio buio.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	Then it stops. The screaming, and the gunshots, both stop abruptly, and the Saryd drops the gun, then collapses to the ground. He lays there, unresponsive, catatonic, as the Heliarch agents head closer to inspect him, eventually blocking him out entirely from view. A few seconds later, some of the Heliarchs back up, then bolt to a restricted room. Others stand firmly on guard, with their guns pointed either at the Saryd, or at the passageway from which he came.|460|0
units.english: Then it stops. The screaming, and the gunshots, both stop abruptly, and the Saryd drops the gun, then collapses to the ground. He lays there, unresponsive, catatonic, as the Heliarch agents head closer to inspect him, eventually blocking him out entirely from view. A few seconds later, some of the Heliarchs back up, then bolt to a restricted room. Others stand firmly on guard, with their guns pointed either at the Saryd, or at the passageway from which he came.
units.italian: Poi si ferma. Le urla e gli spari cessano di colpo, e il Saryd lascia cadere l'arma e crolla a terra. Resta lì, senza reagire, catatonico, mentre gli agenti Heliarch si avvicinano per esaminarlo e alla fine lo nascondono del tutto alla vista. Qualche secondo dopo alcuni Heliarch indietreggiano e poi corrono verso una stanza riservata. Altri restano saldi di guardia, con le armi puntate verso il Saryd o verso il passaggio da cui è venuto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	Eventually, a team comes with what vaguely resembles a very large gurney, and some sort of large sack. The Heliarch agents surrounding the Saryd shuffle out of the way for those carrying the equipment to pass, and within a few minutes they're taking the Saryd away, encased in the sack as if in a body bag, carried on the gurney. Halfway to the shut down section doors, they stop as the Saryd moves erratically inside the sack, kicking and flailing wildly. It stops within a few seconds, and they resume their way out of the quarantined ring portion.|461|0
units.english: Eventually, a team comes with what vaguely resembles a very large gurney, and some sort of large sack. The Heliarch agents surrounding the Saryd shuffle out of the way for those carrying the equipment to pass, and within a few minutes they're taking the Saryd away, encased in the sack as if in a body bag, carried on the gurney. Halfway to the shut down section doors, they stop as the Saryd moves erratically inside the sack, kicking and flailing wildly. It stops within a few seconds, and they resume their way out of the quarantined ring portion.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva una squadra con quello che somiglia vagamente a una barella molto grande e una specie di grosso sacco. Gli agenti Heliarch intorno al Saryd si fanno da parte per lasciar passare chi porta l'attrezzatura e, in pochi minuti, portano via il Saryd, chiuso nel sacco come in un sacco per cadaveri e trasportato sulla barella. A metà strada verso le porte chiuse della sezione si fermano, perché il Saryd si muove in modo irregolare dentro il sacco, scalciando e dimenandosi all'impazzata. Si ferma in pochi secondi, e riprendono la via fuori dalla porzione dell'anello in quarantena.

units.id: mission:Coalition Incident: Ring of Wisdom|	Several minutes pass before the Heliarch agents deem the passageway from where the Saryd ran from to be secure, sending some squads inside while others move to resume the ring section to normal. Once the quarantine is lifted, nearly all civilians rush to their ships, departing immediately.|462|0
units.english: Several minutes pass before the Heliarch agents deem the passageway from where the Saryd ran from to be secure, sending some squads inside while others move to resume the ring section to normal. Once the quarantine is lifted, nearly all civilians rush to their ships, departing immediately.
units.italian: Passano diversi minuti prima che gli agenti Heliarch considerino sicuro il passaggio da cui è corso fuori il Saryd; alcune squadre entrano, mentre altre si muovono per riportare la sezione alla normalità. Sollevata la quarantena, quasi tutti i civili corrono alle proprie navi e partono immediatamente.
